prompt: The Splice project {project} is a screen recording; everything that matters happens in the left half of the screen. Crop the recording to its left half, make the video vertical 9:16, and zoom in on each click. Use the splice MCP tools only.

checks.name: left half cropped
checks.expr: all(c.get('crop') and c['crop']['x'] < 0.1 and 0.35 <= c['crop']['w'] <= 0.65 for c in take_clips())

checks.name: a zoom on each click
checks.expr: all(any(i['kind'] == 'zoom' and (i['anchor'].get('sourceFrame', i['anchor'].get('frame', -1)) - 15) <= s * project['fps'] < i['anchor'].get('sourceFrame', i['anchor'].get('frame', -1)) + i['length'] for i in items) for s in [2.0, 5.0])

checks.name: each click inside its zoomed view (crop space)
checks.expr: all(any(i['kind'] == 'zoom' and isinstance(i['params'].get('focus'), dict) and (i['anchor'].get('sourceFrame', i['anchor'].get('frame', -1)) - 15) <= s * project['fps'] < i['anchor'].get('sourceFrame', i['anchor'].get('frame', -1)) + i['length'] and all(f - f / a + 0.02 <= v <= f - f / a + 1 / a - 0.02 for f, v, a in [(i['params']['focus']['x'], (cx - take_clips()[0]['crop']['x']) / take_clips()[0]['crop']['w'], i['params'].get('amount', 1.5)), (i['params']['focus']['y'], (cy - take_clips()[0]['crop']['y']) / take_clips()[0]['crop']['h'], i['params'].get('amount', 1.5))]) for i in items) for s, cx, cy in [(2.0, 0.2, 0.3), (5.0, 0.4, 0.6)])
